tagline.en: AgiBot's Genie Envisioner — a robotics world model that turns an image and actions into predicted manipulation video.
tagline.zh: AgiBot 的 Genie Envisioner——机器人世界模型,把图像与动作转化为预测的操作视频。

en: Genie Envisioner is a robotics world model from AgiBot (AgibotTech). It predicts how a manipulation scene will unfold, generating video conditioned on a starting image and a sequence of actions — a way to preview what a robot would see as it acts.

It builds on the LTX-Video generation backbone. In WorldFoundry the Genie Envisioner source is vendored in-tree and exposed through a runtime pipeline that resolves its inference entrypoint. Actually generating video additionally requires the Genie Envisioner checkpoints and per-task assets, which are staged separately.
In WorldFoundry you use it for robotics-world-model, image-to-video, and action-conditioned video tasks once those assets are in place.
zh: Genie Envisioner 是 AgiBot(AgibotTech)推出的机器人世界模型。它预测操作场景将如何展开,基于一张起始图像与一段动作序列生成视频——一种预览机器人在动作过程中会看到什么的方式。
它构建在 LTX-Video 生成主干之上。在 WorldFoundry 中,Genie Envisioner 的源码以 in-tree 方式收录,并通过一个运行时 pipeline 暴露,该 pipeline 会解析其推理入口。真正生成视频还需要 Genie Envisioner 的 checkpoint 与各任务资产,这些需单独准备。
在 WorldFoundry 中,当资产就位后,你可将它用于机器人世界模型、图生视频与动作条件化视频等任务。

whenToUse.en: Use Genie Envisioner when you want to predict manipulation video from an image and actions — previewing or evaluating robot behavior in imagination rather than on hardware.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从图像与动作预测操作视频时使用 Genie Envisioner——在想象中而非真机上预览或评估机器人行为。

notFor.en: It generates predicted video rather than issuing control actions, and it can't run until its checkpoints and task assets are downloaded and staged.
notFor.zh: 它生成的是预测视频,而非发出控制动作,在其 checkpoint 与任务资产下载并准备好之前也无法运行。

en: Built on the LTX-Video generation backbone
Predicts manipulation video from an image and actions
Vendored in-tree with a runtime inference pipeline
zh: 来自 AgiBot 的机器人世界模型
构建于 LTX-Video 生成主干
由图像与动作预测操作视频
源码 in-tree 收录,带运行时推理 pipeline
